name: marketplace sync
description: Clone or pull a marketplace and install its plugins into an agent skills folder: one plugin, "all", or with none the ones already installed

name: marketplace enable
description: Switch a disabled plugin's skills back on

name: marketplace disable
description: Switch a plugin's skills off without deleting them: they move to a hidden stash (switch back on with marketplace enable)

name: marketplace add
description: Register a marketplace and clone it, with writes off; asks for a token on the terminal (setup is an alias). Install from it with marketplace sync once writes are on

name: marketplace plugins
description: List the plugins available in a registered marketplace

name: marketplace remove
description: Remove a registered marketplace from the config, and its token from the OS credential store (the local clone and installed skills are kept)

name: status
description: Show every installed skill with its plugin, marketplace, and upstream remote, and whether it is on
